# Phase 14 Plan 01: Empty Module Cell Fixture

A catch-all row names no module, so no row can be emitted without inventing
one. Module-cell normalization strips the parenthetical and leaves nothing —
the manifest must fall back to the original cell text rather than record an
untraceable blank (contract §7).
